name: nebula-container-compiler
//: The CONTAINER-SIDE compiler manifest — installed at /build in the image (see container/Dockerfile), NEVER locally (not a workspace; the file: paths resolve only against the image's /build layout, where the Dockerfile COPYs the package + forks to matching relative paths). Deliberately NOT container/app/package.json: that manifest is the generated app's baked dep tree at /, and the compiler toolchain must not leak into what a user app can resolve. Versions mirror the in-repo pins: typescript+esbuild from packages/ts-runtime-parser-validator/package.json devDependencies, @vue/compiler-sfc from apps/nebula/package.json.
